你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；禁止直接修改 this.data.get(...) 或 computed 返回的对象/数组及其子对象，例如 selectedAsset.decision = value、note.resolved = true、nodes.push(node)、edges.splice(...)、node.status = status；必须用 map、filter、concat、Object.assign({}, ...) 或对象展开创建新的对象/数组，再通过 this.data.set('assets', nextAssets)、this.data.set('nodes', nextNodes) 等方式写回根字段；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的循环项和索引别名必须完整迁移，如果模板表达式使用 index，就必须显式写成 s-for="phase, index in phases trackby phase.key"，禁止只声明 phase 却继续引用未绑定的 index；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；class、style、checked、selected、disabled 等属性、s-if/s-for 指令以及文本插值调用普通方法时，不得把响应式依赖只隐藏在方法内部的 this.data.get(...) 中；必须保留 Vue 模板表达式中的完整参数，或将依赖字段显式传入，例如 class="{{ rowClass(row, winnerId, leaderId) }}"、class="{{ slotClass(device.id, hour, schedule) }}"、s-if="isOpen(module.id, openIds)"、s-for="lesson in visibleLessons(module.lessons, completedIds, unfinishedOnly) trackby lesson.id"、checked="{{ isSelected(row.id, selectedIds) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. Vue 生命周期必须完整迁移：created 中的 prop 派生状态初始化放入 inited，mounted 中的初始方法调用和副作用放入 attached，beforeDestroy/destroyed 中的定时器或监听清理放入 disposed；不能只保留空钩子或只保留钩子名称。依赖 prop 的 data 不得在 initData() 中使用 this.propName 初始化，必须先返回稳定占位值，再在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取、复制并通过 this.data.set(...) 写入。Vue watch: {...} 不会被 San 自动注册，必须在 inited/attached 中使用 this.watch('field', handler)。

13. 必须保留 Vue template 的 DOM 子节点顺序；元素和文本都存在但顺序改变仍属于错误。特别检查 label/th/footer 中 input 或 checkbox 与相邻文字、百分号、按钮的先后关系，不要用 CSS order 或 flex 排序掩盖模板顺序差异。

        "content": "\r\n/* 主容器样式 */\r\n.analytics-dashboard {\r\n  max-width: 1400px;\r\n  margin: 0 auto;\r\n  padding: 20px;\r\n  background: #f8fafc;\r\n  color: #1e293b;\r\n  transition: all 0.3s ease;\r\n  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.analytics-dashboard.dark-mode {\r\n  background: #0f172a;\r\n  color: #e2e8f0;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.analytics-dashboard.compact {\r\n  padding: 12px;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/* 导航栏 */\r\n.dashboard-navbar {\r\n  display: flex;\r\n  justify-content: space-between;\r\n  align-items: center;\r\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\r\n  padding: 16px 20px;\r\n  background: white;\r\n  border-radius: 16px;\r\n  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);\r\n}\r\n\r\n.dark-mode .dashboard-navbar {\r\n  background: #1e293b;\r\n  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);\r\n}\r\n\r\n.logo-section {\r\n  display: flex;\r\n  align-items: center;\r\n  gap: 12px;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.logo-icon {\r\n  font-size: 28px;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.logo-text {\r\n  font-size: 20px;\r\n  font-weight: 700;\r\n  margin: 0;\r\n  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);\r\n  -webkit-background-clip: text;\r\n  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.nav-controls {\r\n  display: flex;\r\n  gap: 12px;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.nav-controls button {\r\n  padding: 8px 16px;\r\n  border: none;\r\n  border-radius: 8px;\r\n  cursor: pointer;\r\n  font-size: 14px;\r\n  transition: all 0.2s;\r\n  background: #f1f5f9;\r\n  color: #475569;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.dark-mode .nav-controls button {\r\n  background: #334155;\r\n  color: #cbd5e1;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.nav-controls button:hover:not(:disabled) {\r\n  transform: translateY(-1px);\r\n  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);\r\n}\r\n\r\n.refresh-btn:disabled {\r\n  opacity: 0.6;\r\n  cursor: not-allowed;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/* 统计卡片网格 */\r\n.stats-grid {\r\n  display: grid;\r\n  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));\r\n  gap: 20px;\r\n  margin-bottom: 32px;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.stat-card {\r\n  background: white;\r\n  border-radius: 16px;\r\n  padding: 20px;\r\n  display: flex;\r\n  align-items: center;\r\n  gap: 16px;\r\n  cursor: pointer;\r\n  transition: all 0.2s;\r\n  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);\r\n}\r\n\r\n.dark-mode .stat-card {\r\n  background: #1e293b;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.stat-card:hover {\r\n  transform: translateY(-4px);\r\n  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);\r\n}\r\n\r\n.stat-card.loading {\r\n  opacity: 0.6;\r\n  pointer-events: none;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.stat-icon {\r\n  font-size: 32px;\r\n  width: 48px;\r\n  height: 48px;\r\n  display: flex;\r\n  align-items: center;\r\n  justify-content: center;\r\n  background: #f1f5f9;\r\n  border-radius: 12px;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.stat-content {\r\n  flex: 1;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.stat-title {\r\n  font-size: 14px;\r\n  color: #64748b;\r\n  margin-bottom: 8px;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.stat-value {\r\n  font-size: 28px;\r\n  font-weight: 700;\r\n  color: #1e293b;\r\n  margin-bottom: #10b981;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.stat-change.negative {\r\n  color: #ef4444;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.stat-change.neutral {\r\n  color: #f59e0b;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/* 可视化区域 */\r\n.visualization-section {\r\n  display: grid;\r\n  grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px;\r\n  gap: 24px;\r\n  margin-bottom: 32px;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.chart-container, .insights-panel {\r\n  background: white;\r\n  border-radius: 16px;\r\n  padding: 20px;\r\n  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);\r\n}\r\n\r\n.dark-mode .chart-container,\r\n.dark-mode .insights-panel {\r\n  background: #1e293b;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.section-title {\r\n  display: flex;\r\n  justify-content: space-between;\r\n  align-items: center;\r\n  margin-bottom: 20px;\r\n  font-size: 18px;\r\n  font-weight: 600;\r\n}\r\n\r\n.period-selector {\r\n  padding: 6px 12px;\r\n  border: 1px <template>
<div class="analytics-dashboard" class="{{isDarkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}} {{isCompactView ? 'compact' : ''}}">
  <div class="dashboard-navbar">
    <div class="logo-section">
      <span class="logo-icon">📈</span>
      <h1 class="logo-text">Analytics Pro</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-controls">
      <button class="view-toggle" on-click="toggleView">{{isCompactView ? '📊 展开视图' : '📋 紧凑视图'}}</button>
      <button class="theme-toggle" on-click="toggleTheme">{{isDarkMode ? '☀️ 亮色' : '🌙 暗色'}}</button>
      <button class="refresh-btn" disabled="{{isLoading}}" on-click="manualRefresh">{{isLoading ? '⏳ 加载中...' : '🔄 刷新数据'}}</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="stats-grid">
    <stat-card
      s-for="stat in statistics" trackby="stat.id"
      key="{{stat.id}}"
      title="{{stat.title}}"
      value="{{stat.value}}"
      change="{{stat.change}}"
      icon="{{stat.icon}}"
      loading="{{isLoading}}"
      on-click="onStatClick"
    />
  </div>
  <div class="visualization-section">
    <div class="chart-container">
      <h3 class="section-title">
        <span>📊 实时访问趋势</span>
        <select class="period-selector" value="{= selectedPeriod =}" on-change="onPeriodChange">
          <option value="7d">最近7天</option>
          <option value="30d">最近30天</option>
          <option value="90d">最近90天</option>
        </select>
      </h3>
      <trend-chart data="{{chartData}}" height="300" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-data-point-click="onDataPointClick"/>
    </div>
    <div class="insights-panel">
      <h3 class="section-title">💡 智能洞察</h3>

        <select class="filter-select" value="{= activityFilter =}" on-change="onFilterChange">
          <option value="all">所有活动</option>
          <option value="login">登录</option>
          <option value="purchase">购买</option>
          <option value="view">浏览</option>
          <option value="share">分享</option>
        </select>

    <activity-table activities="{{filteredActivities}}" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-row-click="onActivityClick"/>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'StatCard',
  components: {
    'stat-card': require('./StatCard'),
    'trend-chart': require('./TrendChart'),
    'insight-list': require('./InsightList'),
    'activity-table': require('./ActivityTable')
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      isCompactView: false,
      isLoading: false,
      selectedPeriod: '30d',
      searchQuery: '',
      activityFilter: 'all',
      statistics: [
        { id: 1, title: '总访问量', value: 28450, change: 12.5, icon: '👥' },
        { id: 2, title: '新增用户', value: 3240, change: -2.3, icon: '🆕' },
        { id: 3, title: '转化率', value: 3.8, change: 0.7, icon: '🎯' },
        { id: 4, title: '总收入', value: 187500, change: 18.9, icon: '💰' }
      ],
      chartData: [],
      insights: [],
      activities: [],
      dataCache: {
        '7d': null,
        '30d': null,
        '90d': null
      },
      eventHistory: []
    };
  },
  computed: {
    filteredActivities() {
      const activities = this.data.get('activities');
      let filtered = [...activities];
      const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
      const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');

      if (searchQuery) {
        const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity =>
          activity.user.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          activity.detail.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );
      }

      if (activityFilter !== 'all') {
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity => activity.type === activityFilter);
      }

      return filtered;
    }
  },
  inited() {
    this.watch('isDarkMode', newVal => {
      this.fire('theme-changed', { darkMode: newVal, timestamp: Date.now() });
      this.addEventToHistory('theme', `主题切换为 ${newVal ? '暗色' : '亮色'} 模式`);
    });

    this.watch('isCompactView', newVal => {
      this.addEventToHistory('view', `视图切换为 ${newVal ? '紧凑' : '展开'} 模式`);
    });
  },
  attached() {
    this.initializeDashboard();
    this.startAutoRefresh();
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘初始化完成');
  },
  disposed() {
    const refreshInterval = this.data.get('refreshInterval');
    if (refreshInterval) {
      clearInterval(refreshInterval);
      this.data.set('refreshInterval', null);
    }
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘组件即将销毁');
  },
  methods: {
    initializeDashboard() {
      this.data.set('isLoading', true);
      Promise.all([
        this.loadChartData(),
        this.loadInsights(),
        this.loadActivities()
      ]).then(() => {
        this.addEventToHistory('success', '所有数据加载成功');
      }).catch(error => {
        this.addEventToHistory('error', `数据加载失败: ${error.message}`);
        this.fire('error', { message: error.message, timestamp: Date.now() });
      }).finally(() => {
        this.data.set('isLoading', false);
      });
    },
    loadChartData() {
      const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
      const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
      if (dataCache[selectedPeriod]) {
        this.data.set('chartData', dataCache[selectedPeriod]);
        this.addEventToHistory('cache', `使用缓存的 ${selectedPeriod} 图表数据`);
        return Promise.resolve();
      }

      return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800)).then(() => {
        const days = selectedPeriod === '7d' ? 7 : (selectedPeriod === '30d' ? 30 : 90);
        const data = [];
        let baseValue = 1000;

        for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
          const variance = Math.sin(i * 0.2) * 200;
          const trend = i * 2;
          baseValue += Math.random() * 30 - 15;
          const value = Math.max(100, Math.floor(baseValue + variance + trend));

          const date = new Date();
          date.setDate(date.getDate() - (days - i));

          data.push({
            date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            label: this.formatDateLabel(date, days),
            value: value
          });
        }

        this.data.set('chartData', data);
        const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: data };
        this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);
        this.addEventToHistory('fetch', `加载了 ${days} 天的图表数据`);
      });
    },
    loadInsights() {
      return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600)).then(() => {
        const insightsData = [
          {
            id: 1,
            title: '用户活跃度提升',
            description: '过去7天用户访问时长增加了23%，主要集中在移动端',
            icon: '🚀',
            color: '#10b981',
            trend: 23,
            timestamp: '2分钟前'
          },
          {
            id: 2,
            title: '转化率优化建议',
            description: '购物车放弃率较高，建议优化结账流程',
            icon: '🛒',
            color: '#f59e0b',
            trend: -5,
            timestamp: '15分钟前'
          },
          {
            id: 3,
            title: '新用户增长高峰',
            description: '社交媒体渠道带来大量新用户，增长42%',
            icon: '📱',
            color: '#3b82f6',
            trend: 42,
            timestamp: '1小时前'
          },
          {
            id: 4,
            title: '服务器响应优化',
            description: 'API响应时间降低15%，用户体验改善',
            icon: '⚡',
            color: '#8b5cf6',
            trend: 15,
            timestamp: '3小时前'
          }
        ];
        this.data.set('insights', insightsData);
      });
    },
    loadActivities() {
      return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500)).then(() => {
        const activities = [];
        const users = ['张三', '李四', '王五', '赵六', '钱七'];
        const types = ['login', 'purchase', 'view', 'share'];
        const details = {
          login: ['登录成功', '登录失败', '异地登录'],
          purchase: ['购买商品A', '购买商品B', '订阅会员'],
          view: ['浏览首页', '查看详情页', '搜索关键词'],
          share: ['分享链接', '邀请好友', '发布评论']
        };

        for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
          const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
          const status = Math.random() > 0.8 ? 'failed' : (Math.random() > 0.9 ? 'pending' : 'success');

          activities.push({
            id: Date.now() + i,
            timestamp: Date.now() - Math.random() * 3600000,
            user: users[Math.floor(Math.random() * users.length)],
            type: type,
            detail: details[type][Math.floor(Math.random() * details[type].length)],
            status: status
          });
        }

        activities.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);
        this.data.set('activities', activities);
      });
    },
    manualRefresh() {
      if (this.data.get('isLoading')) return;

      this.data.set('isLoading', true);
      this.addEventToHistory('action', '用户手动刷新数据');

      const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
      const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
      const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
      this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

      Promise.all([
        this.loadChartData(),
        this.loadInsights(),
        this.loadActivities()
      ]).then(() => {
        this.addEventToHistory('success', '数据刷新完成');
        const statistics = this.data.get('statistics');
        this.fire('data-refreshed', {
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          period: selectedPeriod,
          statistics: statistics
        });
      }).catch(error => {
        this.addEventToHistory('error', `刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
        this.fire('error', { message: error.message });
      }).finally(() => {
        this.data.set('isLoading', false);
      });
    },
    startAutoRefresh() {
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if (!this.data.get('isLoading')) {
          this.autoRefresh();
        }
      }, 30000);
      this.data.set('refreshInterval', interval);
    },
    autoRefresh() {
      this.addEventToHistory('system', '自动刷新数据');
      const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
      const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
      const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
      this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

      this.loadChartData()
        .then(() => this.loadInsights())
        .then(() => this.loadActivities())
        .then(() => {
          this.addEventToHistory('success', '自动数据同步完成');
        })
        .catch(error => {
          this.addEventToHistory('error', `自动刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
        });
    },
    toggleTheme() {
      const isDarkMode = this.data.get('isDarkMode');
      this.data.set('isDarkMode', !isDarkMode);
    },
    toggleView() {
      const isCompactView = this.data.get('isCompactView');
      this.data.set('isCompactView', !isCompactView);
    },
    onPeriodChange() {
      const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
      this.addEventToHistory('filter', `切换时间段为: ${selectedPeriod}`);
      this.loadChartData();
    },
    onSearchChange() {
      const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
      this.addEventToHistory('filter', `搜索关键词: ${searchQuery || '清空'}`);
    },
    onFilterChange() {
      const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');
      this.addEventToHistory('filter', `活动类型过滤: ${activityFilter}`);
    },
    onStatClick(stat) {
      this.addEventToHistory('click', `点击统计卡片: ${stat.title} (${stat.value})`);
      this.fire('stat-click', { stat, timestamp: Date.now() });
    },
    onDataPointClick(data) {
      this.addEventToHistory('chart', `点击数据点: 日期 ${data.date}, 值 ${data.value}`);
      this.fire('chart-point-click', data);
    },
    onInsightClick(insight) {
      this.addEventToHistory('insight', `查看洞察: ${insight.title}`);
      this.fire('insight-click', insight);
    },
    onActivityClick(activity) {
      this.addEventToHistory('activity', `查看活动: ${activity.user} - ${activity.type}`);
      this.fire('activity-click', activity);
    },
    formatDateLabel(date, totalDays) {
      if (totalDays <= 30) {
        return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`;
      }
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}月`;
    },
    addEventToHistory(type, message) {
      const event = {
        type,
        message,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        timeStr: new Date().toLocaleTimeString()
      };

      const history = this.data.get('eventHistory');
      const newHistory = [event, ...history];
      if (newHistory.length > 50) {
        newHistory.pop();
      }
      this.data.set('eventHistory', newHistory);

      if (typeof console !== 'undefined') {
        console.log(`[${event.timeStr}] ${message}`);
      }
    }
  }
});
</script>

<template>
<div class="analytics-dashboard" class="{{isDarkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}} {{isCompactView ? 'compact' : ''}}">
  <div class="dashboard-navbar">
    <div class="logo-section">
      <span class="logo-icon">📈</span>
      <h1 class="logo-text">Analytics Pro</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-controls">
      <button class="view-toggle" on-click="toggleView">{{isCompactView ? '📊 展开视图' : '📋 紧凑视图'}}</button>
      <button class="theme-toggle" on-click="toggleTheme">{{isDarkMode ? '☀️ 亮色' : '🌙 暗色'}}</button>
      <button class="refresh-btn" disabled="{{isLoading}}" on-click="manualRefresh">{{isLoading ? '⏳ 加载中...' : '🔄 刷新数据'}}</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="stats-grid">
    <stat-card
      s-for="stat in statistics" trackby="stat.id"
      title="{{stat.title}}"
      value="{{stat.value}}"
      change="{{stat.change}}"
      icon="{{stat.icon}}"
      loading="{{isLoading}}"
      on-click="onStatClick(stat)"
    />
  </div>
  <div class="visualization-section">
    <div class="chart-container">
      <h3 class="section-title">
        <span>📊 实时访问趋势</span>
        <select class="period-selector" value="{= selectedPeriod =}" on-change="onPeriodChange">
          <option value="7d">最近7天</option>
          <option value="30d">最近30天</option>
          <option value="90d">最近90天</option>
        </select>
      </h3>
      <trend-chart data="{{chartData}}" height="300" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-data-point-click="onDataPointClick"/>
    </div>
    <div class="insights-panel">
      <h3 class="section-title">💡 智能洞察</h3>
      <insight-list insights="{{insights}}" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-insight-click="onInsightClick"/>
    </div>
  </div>

    <div class="activity-header">
      <h3 class="section-title">📋 实时用户活动</h3>
      <div class="filter-controls">
        <input type="text" placeholder="搜索用户或操作..." class="search-input" value="{= searchQuery =}" on-input="onSearchChange"/>
        <select class="filter-select" value="{= activityFilter =}" on-change="onFilterChange">
          <option value="all">所有活动</option>
          <option value="login">登录</option>
          <option value="purchase">购买</option>
          <option value="view">浏览</option>
          <option value="share">分享</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <activity-table activities="{{filteredActivities}}" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-row-click="onActivityClick"/>

    <p>正在加载最新数据...</p>
  </div>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'StatCard',
  components: {
    'stat-card': require('./StatCard'),
    'trend-chart': require('./TrendChart'),
    'insight-list': require('./InsightList'),
    'activity-table': require('./ActivityTable')
  },
  dataTypes: {
    userId: DataTypes.string,
    apiEndpoint: DataTypes.string
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      isCompactView: false,
      isLoading: false,
      selectedPeriod: '30d',
      searchQuery: '',
      activityFilter: 'all',
      statistics: [
        { id: 1, title: '总访问量', value: 28450, change: 12.5, icon: '👥' },
        { id: 2, title: '新增用户', value: 3240, change: -2.3, icon: '🆕' },
        { id: 3, title: '转化率', value: 3.8, change: 0.7, icon: '🎯' },
        { id: 4, title: '总收入', value: 187500, change: 18.9, icon: '💰' }
      ],
      chartData: [],
      insights: [],
      activities: [],
      dataCache: {
        '7d': null,
        '30d': null,
        '90d': null
      },
      eventHistory: [],
      userId: 'anonymous',
      apiEndpoint: 'https://api.example.com/analytics'
    };
  },
  computed: {
    filteredActivities() {
      const activities = this.data.get('activities');
      let filtered = [...activities];
      const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
      const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');

      if (searchQuery) {
        const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity =>
          activity.user.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          activity.detail.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );
      }

      if (activityFilter !== 'all') {
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity => activity.type === activityFilter);
      }

      return filtered;
    }
  },
  inited() {
    this.watch('isDarkMode', newVal => {
      this.fire('theme-changed', { darkMode: newVal, timestamp: Date.now() });
      this.addEventToHistory('theme', `主题切换为 ${newVal ? '暗色' : '亮色'} 模式`);
    });

    this.watch('isCompactView', newVal => {
      this.addEventToHistory('view', `视图切换为 ${newVal ? '紧凑' : '展开'} 模式`);
    });
  },
  attached() {
    this.initializeDashboard();
    this.startAutoRefresh();
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘初始化完成');
  },
  disposed() {
    const refreshInterval = this.data.get('refreshInterval');
    if (refreshInterval) {
      clearInterval(refreshInterval);
      this.data.set('refreshInterval', null);
    }
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘组件即将销毁');
  },
  initializeDashboard() {
    this.data.set('isLoading', true);
    Promise.all([
      this.loadChartData(),
      this.loadInsights(),
      this.loadActivities()
    ]).then(() => {
      this.addEventToHistory('success', '所有数据加载成功');
    }).catch(error => {
      this.addEventToHistory('error', `数据加载失败: ${error.message}`);
      this.fire('error', { message: error.message, timestamp: Date.now() });
    }).finally(() => {
      this.data.set('isLoading', false);
    });
  },
  loadChartData() {
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    if (dataCache[selectedPeriod]) {
      this.data.set('chartData', dataCache[selectedPeriod]);
      this.addEventToHistory('cache', `使用缓存的 ${selectedPeriod} 图表数据`);
      return Promise.resolve();
    }

    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800)).then(() => {
      const days = selectedPeriod === '7d' ? 7 : (selectedPeriod === '30d' ? 30 : 90);
      const data = [];
      let baseValue = 1000;

      for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
        const variance = Math.sin(i * 0.2) * 200;
        const trend = i * 2;
        baseValue += Math.random() * 30 - 15;
        const value = Math.max(100, Math.floor(baseValue + variance + trend));

        const date = new Date();
        date.setDate(date.getDate() - (days - i));

        data.push({
          date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
          label: this.formatDateLabel(date, days),
          value: value
        });
      }

      this.data.set('chartData', data);
      const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: data };
      this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);
      this.addEventToHistory('fetch', `加载了 ${days} 天的图表数据`);
    });
  },
  loadInsights() {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600)).then(() => {
      const insightsData = [
        {
          id: 1,
          title: '用户活跃度提升',
          description: '过去7天用户访问时长增加了23%，主要集中在移动端',
          icon: '🚀',
          color: '#10b981',
          trend: 23,
          timestamp: '2分钟前'
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          title: '转化率优化建议',
          description: '购物车放弃率较高，建议优化结账流程',
          icon: '🛒',
          color: '#f59e0b',
          trend: -5,
          timestamp: '15分钟前'
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          title: '新用户增长高峰',
          description: '社交媒体渠道带来大量新用户，增长42%',
          icon: '📱',
          color: '#3b82f6',
          trend: 42,
          timestamp: '1小时前'
        },
        {
          id: 4,
          title: '服务器响应优化',
          description: 'API响应时间降低15%，用户体验改善',
          icon: '⚡',
          color: '#8b5cf6',
          trend: 15,
          timestamp: '3小时前'
        }
      ];
      this.data.set('insights', insightsData);
    });
  },
  loadActivities() {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500)).then(() => {
      const activities = [];
      const users = ['张三', '李四', '王五', '赵六', '钱七'];
      const types = ['login', 'purchase', 'view', 'share'];
      const details = {
        login: ['登录成功', '登录失败', '异地登录'],
        purchase: ['购买商品A', '购买商品B', '订阅会员'],
        view: ['浏览首页', '查看详情页', '搜索关键词'],
        share: ['分享链接', '邀请好友', '发布评论']
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
        const status = Math.random() > 0.8 ? 'failed' : (Math.random() > 0.9 ? 'pending' : 'success');

        activities.push({
          id: Date.now() + i,
          timestamp: Date.now() - Math.random() * 3600000,
          user: users[Math.floor(Math.random() * users.length)],
          type: type,
          detail: details[type][Math.floor(Math.random() * details[type].length)],
          status: status
        });
      }

      activities.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);
      this.data.set('activities', activities);
    });
  },
  manualRefresh() {
    if (this.data.get('isLoading')) return;

    this.data.set('isLoading', true);
    this.addEventToHistory('action', '用户手动刷新数据');

    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
    this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

    Promise.all([
      this.loadChartData(),
      this.loadInsights(),
      this.loadActivities()
    ]).then(() => {
      this.addEventToHistory('success', '数据刷新完成');
      const statistics = this.data.get('statistics');
      this.fire('data-refreshed', {
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        period: selectedPeriod,
        statistics: statistics
      });
    }).catch(error => {
      this.addEventToHistory('error', `刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
      this.fire('error', { message: error.message });
    }).finally(() => {
      this.data.set('isLoading', false);
    });
  },
  startAutoRefresh() {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!this.data.get('isLoading')) {
        this.autoRefresh();
      }
    }, 30000);
    this.data.set('refreshInterval', interval);
  },
  autoRefresh() {
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '自动刷新数据');
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
    this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

    this.loadChartData()
      .then(() => this.loadInsights())
      .then(() => this.loadActivities())
      .then(() => {
        this.addEventToHistory('success', '自动数据同步完成');
      })
      .catch(error => {
        this.addEventToHistory('error', `自动刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
      });
  },
  toggleTheme() {
    const isDarkMode = this.data.get('isDarkMode');
    this.data.set('isDarkMode', !isDarkMode);
  },
  toggleView() {
    const isCompactView = this.data.get('isCompactView');
    this.data.set('isCompactView', !isCompactView);
  },
  onPeriodChange() {
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `切换时间段为: ${selectedPeriod}`);
    this.loadChartData();
  },
  onSearchChange() {
    const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `搜索关键词: ${searchQuery || '清空'}`);
  },
  onFilterChange() {
    const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `活动类型过滤: ${activityFilter}`);
  },
  onStatClick(stat) {
    this.addEventToHistory('click', `点击统计卡片: ${stat.title} (${stat.value})`);
    this.fire('stat-click', { stat, timestamp: Date.now() });
  },
  onDataPointClick(data) {
    this.addEventToHistory('chart', `点击数据点: 日期 ${data.date}, 值 ${data.value}`);
    this.fire('chart-point-click', data);
  },
  onInsightClick(insight) {
    this.addEventToHistory('insight', `查看洞察: ${insight.title}`);
    this.fire('insight-click', insight);
  },
  onActivityClick(activity) {
    this.addEventToHistory('activity', `查看活动: ${activity.user} - ${activity.type}`);
    this.fire('activity-click', activity);
  },
  formatDateLabel(date, totalDays) {
    if (totalDays <= 30) {
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`;
    }
    return `${date.getMonth() + 1}月`;
  },
  addEventToHistory(type, message) {
    const event = {
      type,
      message,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      timeStr: new Date().toLocaleTimeString()
    };

    const history = this.data.get('eventHistory');
    const newHistory = [event, ...history];
    if (newHistory.length > 50) {
      newHistory.pop();
    }
    this.data.set('eventHistory', newHistory);

    if (typeof console !== 'undefined') {
      console.log(`[${event.timeStr}] ${message}`);
    }
  }
});
</script>

7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的循环项和索引别名必须完整迁移，如果模板表达式使用 index，就必须显式写成 s-for="phase, index in phases trackby phase.key"，禁止只声明 phase 却继续引用未绑定的 index；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；class、style、checked、selected、disabled 等属性、s-if/s-for 指令以及文本插值调用普通方法时，不得把响应式依赖只隐藏在方法内部的 this.data.get(...) 中；必须保留 Vue 模板表达式中的完整参数，或将依赖字段显式传入，例如 class="{{ rowClass(row, winnerId, leaderId) }}"、class="{{ slotClass(device.id, hour, schedule) }}"、s-if="isOpen(module.id, openIds)"、s-for="lesson in visibleLessons(module.lessons, completedIds, unfinishedOnly) trackby lesson.id"、checked="{{ isSelected(row.id, selectedIds) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。

Vue 生命周期必须完整迁移：created 中的 prop 派生状态初始化放入 inited，mounted 中的初始方法调用和副作用放入 attached，beforeDestroy/destroyed 中的定时器或监听清理放入 disposed；不能只保留空钩子或只保留钩子名称。依赖 prop 的 data 不得在 initData() 中使用 this.propName 初始化，必须先返回稳定占位值，再在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取、复制并通过 this.data.set(...) 写入。Vue watch: {...} 不会被 San 自动注册，必须在 inited/attached 中使用 this.watch('field', handler)。

<template>
<div class="analytics-dashboard" class="{{isDarkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}} {{isCompactView ? 'compact' : ''}}">
  <div class="dashboard-navbar">
    <div class="logo-section">
      <span class="logo-icon">📈</span>
      <h1 class="logo-text">Analytics Pro</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-controls">
      <button class="view-toggle" on-click="toggleView">{{isCompactView ? '📊 展开视图' : '📋 紧凑视图'}}</button>
      <button class="theme-toggle" on-click="toggleTheme">{{isDarkMode ? '☀️ 亮色' : '🌙 暗色'}}</button>
      <button class="refresh-btn" disabled="{{isLoading}}" on-click="manualRefresh">{{isLoading ? '⏳ 加载中...' : '🔄 刷新数据'}}</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="stats-grid">
    <stat-card
      s-for="stat in statistics" trackby="stat.id"
      title="{{stat.title}}"
      value="{{stat.value}}"
      change="{{stat.change}}"
      icon="{{stat.icon}}"
      loading="{{isLoading}}"
      on-click="onStatClick(stat)"
    />
  </div>
  <div class="visualization-section">
    <div class="chart-container">
      <h3 class="section-title">
        <span>📊 实时访问趋势</span>
        <select class="period-selector" value="{= selectedPeriod =}" on-change="onPeriodChange">
          <option value="7d">最近7天</option>
          <option value="30d">最近30天</option>
          <option value="90d">最近90天</option>
        </select>
      </h3>
      <trend-chart data="{{chartData}}" height="300" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-data-point-click="onDataPointClick"/>
    </div>
    <div class="insights-panel">
      <h3 class="section-title">💡 智能洞察</h3>
      <insight-list insights="{{insights}}" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-insight-click="onInsightClick"/>
    </div>
  </div>

    <div class="activity-header">
      <h3 class="section-title">📋 实时用户活动</h3>
      <div class="filter-controls">
        <input type="text" placeholder="搜索用户或操作..." class="search-input" value="{= searchQuery =}" on-input="onSearchChange"/>
        <select class="filter-select" value="{= activityFilter =}" on-change="onFilterChange">
          <option value="all">所有活动</option>
          <option value="login">登录</option>
          <option value="purchase">购买</option>
          <option value="view">浏览</option>
          <option value="share">分享</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <activity-table activities="{{filteredActivities}}" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-row-click="onActivityClick"/>

    <p>正在加载最新数据...</p>
  </div>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'StatCard',
  components: {
    'stat-card': require('./StatCard'),
    'trend-chart': require('./TrendChart'),
    'insight-list': require('./InsightList'),
    'activity-table': require('./ActivityTable')
  },
  dataTypes: {
    userId: DataTypes.string,
    apiEndpoint: DataTypes.string
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      isCompactView: false,
      isLoading: false,
      selectedPeriod: '30d',
      searchQuery: '',
      activityFilter: 'all',
      statistics: [
        { id: 1, title: '总访问量', value: 28450, change: 12.5, icon: '👥' },
        { id: 2, title: '新增用户', value: 3240, change: -2.3, icon: '🆕' },
        { id: 3, title: '转化率', value: 3.8, change: 0.7, icon: '🎯' },
        { id: 4, title: '总收入', value: 187500, change: 18.9, icon: '💰' }
      ],
      chartData: [],
      insights: [],
      activities: [],
      dataCache: {
        '7d': null,
        '30d': null,
        '90d': null
      },
      eventHistory: [],
      userId: 'anonymous',
      apiEndpoint: 'https://api.example.com/analytics'
    };
  },
  computed: {
    filteredActivities() {
      const activities = this.data.get('activities');
      let filtered = [...activities];
      const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
      const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');

      if (searchQuery) {
        const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity =>
          activity.user.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          activity.detail.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );
      }

      if (activityFilter !== 'all') {
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity => activity.type === activityFilter);
      }

      return filtered;
    }
  },
  inited() {
    this.watch('isDarkMode', newVal => {
      this.fire('theme-changed', { darkMode: newVal, timestamp: Date.now() });
      this.addEventToHistory('theme', `主题切换为 ${newVal ? '暗色' : '亮色'} 模式`);
    });

    this.watch('isCompactView', newVal => {
      this.addEventToHistory('view', `视图切换为 ${newVal ? '紧凑' : '展开'} 模式`);
    });
  },
  attached() {
    this.initializeDashboard();
    this.startAutoRefresh();
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘初始化完成');
  },
  disposed() {
    const refreshInterval = this.data.get('refreshInterval');
    if (refreshInterval) {
      clearInterval(refreshInterval);
      this.data.set('refreshInterval', null);
    }
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘组件即将销毁');
  },
  initializeDashboard() {
    this.data.set('isLoading', true);
    Promise.all([
      this.loadChartData(),
      this.loadInsights(),
      this.loadActivities()
    ]).then(() => {
      this.addEventToHistory('success', '所有数据加载成功');
    }).catch(error => {
      this.addEventToHistory('error', `数据加载失败: ${error.message}`);
      this.fire('error', { message: error.message, timestamp: Date.now() });
    }).finally(() => {
      this.data.set('isLoading', false);
    });
  },
  loadChartData() {
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    if (dataCache[selectedPeriod]) {
      this.data.set('chartData', dataCache[selectedPeriod]);
      this.addEventToHistory('cache', `使用缓存的 ${selectedPeriod} 图表数据`);
      return Promise.resolve();
    }

    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800)).then(() => {
      const days = selectedPeriod === '7d' ? 7 : (selectedPeriod === '30d' ? 30 : 90);
      const data = [];
      let baseValue = 1000;

      for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
        const variance = Math.sin(i * 0.2) * 200;
        const trend = i * 2;
        baseValue += Math.random() * 30 - 15;
        const value = Math.max(100, Math.floor(baseValue + variance + trend));

        const date = new Date();
        date.setDate(date.getDate() - (days - i));

        data.push({
          date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
          label: this.formatDateLabel(date, days),
          value: value
        });
      }

      this.data.set('chartData', data);
      const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: data };
      this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);
      this.addEventToHistory('fetch', `加载了 ${days} 天的图表数据`);
    });
  },
  loadInsights() {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600)).then(() => {
      const insightsData = [
        {
          id: 1,
          title: '用户活跃度提升',
          description: '过去7天用户访问时长增加了23%，主要集中在移动端',
          icon: '🚀',
          color: '#10b981',
          trend: 23,
          timestamp: '2分钟前'
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          title: '转化率优化建议',
          description: '购物车放弃率较高，建议优化结账流程',
          icon: '🛒',
          color: '#f59e0b',
          trend: -5,
          timestamp: '15分钟前'
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          title: '新用户增长高峰',
          description: '社交媒体渠道带来大量新用户，增长42%',
          icon: '📱',
          color: '#3b82f6',
          trend: 42,
          timestamp: '1小时前'
        },
        {
          id: 4,
          title: '服务器响应优化',
          description: 'API响应时间降低15%，用户体验改善',
          icon: '⚡',
          color: '#8b5cf6',
          trend: 15,
          timestamp: '3小时前'
        }
      ];
      this.data.set('insights', insightsData);
    });
  },
  loadActivities() {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500)).then(() => {
      const activities = [];
      const users = ['张三', '李四', '王五', '赵六', '钱七'];
      const types = ['login', 'purchase', 'view', 'share'];
      const details = {
        login: ['登录成功', '登录失败', '异地登录'],
        purchase: ['购买商品A', '购买商品B', '订阅会员'],
        view: ['浏览首页', '查看详情页', '搜索关键词'],
        share: ['分享链接', '邀请好友', '发布评论']
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
        const status = Math.random() > 0.8 ? 'failed' : (Math.random() > 0.9 ? 'pending' : 'success');

        activities.push({
          id: Date.now() + i,
          timestamp: Date.now() - Math.random() * 3600000,
          user: users[Math.floor(Math.random() * users.length)],
          type: type,
          detail: details[type][Math.floor(Math.random() * details[type].length)],
          status: status
        });
      }

      activities.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);
      this.data.set('activities', activities);
    });
  },
  manualRefresh() {
    if (this.data.get('isLoading')) return;

    this.data.set('isLoading', true);
    this.addEventToHistory('action', '用户手动刷新数据');

    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
    this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

    Promise.all([
      this.loadChartData(),
      this.loadInsights(),
      this.loadActivities()
    ]).then(() => {
      this.addEventToHistory('success', '数据刷新完成');
      const statistics = this.data.get('statistics');
      this.fire('data-refreshed', {
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        period: selectedPeriod,
        statistics: statistics
      });
    }).catch(error => {
      this.addEventToHistory('error', `刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
      this.fire('error', { message: error.message });
    }).finally(() => {
      this.data.set('isLoading', false);
    });
  },
  startAutoRefresh() {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!this.data.get('isLoading')) {
        this.autoRefresh();
      }
    }, 30000);
    this.data.set('refreshInterval', interval);
  },
  autoRefresh() {
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '自动刷新数据');
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
    this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

    this.loadChartData()
      .then(() => this.loadInsights())
      .then(() => this.loadActivities())
      .then(() => {
        this.addEventToHistory('success', '自动数据同步完成');
      })
      .catch(error => {
        this.addEventToHistory('error', `自动刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
      });
  },
  toggleTheme() {
    const isDarkMode = this.data.get('isDarkMode');
    this.data.set('isDarkMode', !isDarkMode);
  },
  toggleView() {
    const isCompactView = this.data.get('isCompactView');
    this.data.set('isCompactView', !isCompactView);
  },
  onPeriodChange() {
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    this.data.set('selectedPeriod', selectedPeriod);
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `切换时间段为: ${selectedPeriod}`);
    this.loadChartData();
  },
  onSearchChange() {
    const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
    this.data.set('searchQuery', searchQuery);
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `搜索关键词: ${searchQuery || '清空'}`);
  },
  onFilterChange() {
    const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');
    this.data.set('activityFilter', activityFilter);
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `活动类型过滤: ${activityFilter}`);
  },
  onStatClick(stat) {
    this.addEventToHistory('click', `点击统计卡片: ${stat.title} (${stat.value})`);
    this.fire('stat-click', { stat, timestamp: Date.now() });
  },
  onDataPointClick(data) {
    this.addEventToHistory('chart', `点击数据点: 日期 ${data.date}, 值 ${data.value}`);
    this.fire('chart-point-click', data);
  },
  onInsightClick(insight) {
    this.addEventToHistory('insight', `查看洞察: ${insight.title}`);
    this.fire('insight-click', insight);
  },
  onActivityClick(activity) {
    this.addEventToHistory('activity', `查看活动: ${activity.user} - ${activity.type}`);
    this.fire('activity-click', activity);
  },
  formatDateLabel(date, totalDays) {
    if (totalDays <= 30) {
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`;
    }
    return `${date.getMonth() + 1}月`;
  },
  addEventToHistory(type, message) {
    const event = {
      type,
      message,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      timeStr: new Date().toLocaleTimeString()
    };

    const history = this.data.get('eventHistory');
    const newHistory = [event, ...history];
    if (newHistory.length > 50) {
      newHistory.pop();
    }
    this.data.set('eventHistory', newHistory);

    if (typeof console !== 'undefined') {
      console.log(`[${event.timeStr}] ${message}`);
    }
  }
});
</script>

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；禁止直接修改 this.data.get(...) 或 computed 返回的对象/数组及其子对象，例如 selectedAsset.decision = value、note.resolved = true、nodes.push(node)、edges.splice(...)、node.status = status；必须用 map、filter、concat、Object.assign({}, ...) 或对象展开创建新的对象/数组，再通过 this.data.set('assets', nextAssets)、this.data.set('nodes', nextNodes) 等方式写回根字段；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的循环项和索引别名必须完整迁移，如果模板表达式使用 index，就必须显式写成 s-for="phase, index in phases trackby phase.key"，禁止只声明 phase 却继续引用未绑定的 index；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；class、style、checked、selected、disabled 等属性、s-if/s-for 指令以及文本插值调用普通方法时，不得把响应式依赖只隐藏在方法内部的 this.data.get(...) 中；必须保留 Vue 模板表达式中的完整参数，或将依赖字段显式传入，例如 class="{{ rowClass(row, winnerId, leaderId) }}"、class="{{ slotClass(device.id, hour, schedule) }}"、s-if="isOpen(module.id, openIds)"、s-for="lesson in visibleLessons(module.lessons, completedIds, unfinishedOnly) trackby lesson.id"、checked="{{ isSelected(row.id, selectedIds) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'StatCard',
  components: {
    'stat-card': require('./StatCard'),
    'trend-chart': require('./TrendChart'),
    'insight-list': require('./InsightList'),
    'activity-table': require('./ActivityTable')
  },
  dataTypes: {
    userId: DataTypes.string,
    apiEndpoint: DataTypes.string
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      isCompactView: false,
      isLoading: false,
      selectedPeriod: '30d',
      searchQuery: '',
      activityFilter: 'all',
      statistics: [
        { id: 1, title: '总访问量', value: 28450, change: 12.5, icon: '👥' },
        { id: 2, title: '新增用户', value: 3240, change: -2.3, icon: '🆕' },
        { id: 3, title: '转化率', value: 3.8, change: 0.7, icon: '🎯' },
        { id: 4, title: '总收入', value: 187500, change: 18.9, icon: '💰' }
      ],
      chartData: [],
      insights: [],
      activities: [],
      dataCache: {
        '7d': null,
        '30d': null,
        '90d': null
      },
      eventHistory: [],
      userId: 'anonymous',
      apiEndpoint: 'https://api.example.com/analytics'
    };
  },
  computed: {
    filteredActivities() {
      const activities = this.data.get('activities');
      let filtered = [...activities];
      const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
      const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');

      if (searchQuery) {
        const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity =>
          activity.user.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          activity.detail.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );
      }

      if (activityFilter !== 'all') {
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity => activity.type === activityFilter);
      }

      return filtered;
    }
  },
  inited() {
    this.watch('isDarkMode', newVal => {
      this.fire('theme-changed', { darkMode: newVal, timestamp: Date.now() });
      this.addEventToHistory('theme', `主题切换为 ${newVal ? '暗色' : '亮色'} 模式`);
    });

    this.watch('isCompactView', newVal => {
      this.addEventToHistory('view', `视图切换为 ${newVal ? '紧凑' : '展开'} 模式`);
    });
  },
  attached() {
    this.initializeDashboard();
    this.startAutoRefresh();
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘初始化完成');
  },
  disposed() {
    const refreshInterval = this.data.get('refreshInterval');
    if (refreshInterval) {
      clearInterval(refreshInterval);
      this.data.set('refreshInterval', null);
    }
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘组件即将销毁');
  },
  initializeDashboard() {
    this.data.set('isLoading', true);
    Promise.all([
      this.loadChartData(),
      this.loadInsights(),
      this.loadActivities()
    ]).then(() => {
      this.addEventToHistory('success', '所有数据加载成功');
    }).catch(error => {
      this.addEventToHistory('error', `数据加载失败: ${error.message}`);
      this.fire('error', { message: error.message, timestamp: Date.now() });
    }).finally(() => {
      this.data.set('isLoading', false);
    });
  },
  loadChartData() {
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    if (dataCache[selectedPeriod]) {
      this.data.set('chartData', dataCache[selectedPeriod]);
      this.addEventToHistory('cache', `使用缓存的 ${selectedPeriod} 图表数据`);
      return Promise.resolve();
    }

    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800)).then(() => {
      const days = selectedPeriod === '7d' ? 7 : (selectedPeriod === '30d' ? 30 : 90);
      const data = [];
      let baseValue = 1000;

      for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
        const variance = Math.sin(i * 0.2) * 200;
        const trend = i * 2;
        baseValue += Math.random() * 30 - 15;
        const value = Math.max(100, Math.floor(baseValue + variance + trend));

        const date = new Date();
        date.setDate(date.getDate() - (days - i));

        data.push({
          date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
          label: this.formatDateLabel(date, days),
          value: value
        });
      }

      this.data.set('chartData', data);
      const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: data };
      this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);
      this.addEventToHistory('fetch', `加载了 ${days} 天的图表数据`);
    });
  },
  loadInsights() {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600)).then(() => {
      const insightsData = [
        {
          id: 1,
          title: '用户活跃度提升',
          description: '过去7天用户访问时长增加了23%，主要集中在移动端',
          icon: '🚀',
          color: '#10b981',
          trend: 23,
          timestamp: '2分钟前'
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          title: '转化率优化建议',
          description: '购物车放弃率较高，建议优化结账流程',
          icon: '🛒',
          color: '#f59e0b',
          trend: -5,
          timestamp: '15分钟前'
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          title: '新用户增长高峰',
          description: '社交媒体渠道带来大量新用户，增长42%',
          icon: '📱',
          color: '#3b82f6',
          trend: 42,
          timestamp: '1小时前'
        },
        {
          id: 4,
          title: '服务器响应优化',
          description: 'API响应时间降低15%，用户体验改善',
          icon: '⚡',
          color: '#8b5cf6',
          trend: 15,
          timestamp: '3小时前'
        }
      ];
      this.data.set('insights', insightsData);
    });
  },
  loadActivities() {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500)).then(() => {
      const activities = [];
      const users = ['张三', '李四', '王五', '赵六', '钱七'];
      const types = ['login', 'purchase', 'view', 'share'];
      const details = {
        login: ['登录成功', '登录失败', '异地登录'],
        purchase: ['购买商品A', '购买商品B', '订阅会员'],
        view: ['浏览首页', '查看详情页', '搜索关键词'],
        share: ['分享链接', '邀请好友', '发布评论']
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
        const status = Math.random() > 0.8 ? 'failed' : (Math.random() > 0.9 ? 'pending' : 'success');

        activities.push({
          id: Date.now() + i,
          timestamp: Date.now() - Math.random() * 3600000,
          user: users[Math.floor(Math.random() * users.length)],
          type: type,
          detail: details[type][Math.floor(Math.random() * details[type].length)],
          status: status
        });
      }

      activities.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);
      this.data.set('activities', activities);
    });
  },
  manualRefresh() {
    if (this.data.get('isLoading')) return;

    this.data.set('isLoading', true);
    this.addEventToHistory('action', '用户手动刷新数据');

    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
    this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

    Promise.all([
      this.loadChartData(),
      this.loadInsights(),
      this.loadActivities()
    ]).then(() => {
      this.addEventToHistory('success', '数据刷新完成');
      const statistics = this.data.get('statistics');
      this.fire('data-refreshed', {
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        period: selectedPeriod,
        statistics: statistics
      });
    }).catch(error => {
      this.addEventToHistory('error', `刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
      this.fire('error', { message: error.message });
    }).finally(() => {
      this.data.set('isLoading', false);
    });
  },
  startAutoRefresh() {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!this.data.get('isLoading')) {
        this.autoRefresh();
      }
    }, 30000);
    this.data.set('refreshInterval', interval);
  },
  autoRefresh() {
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '自动刷新数据');
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
    this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

    this.loadChartData()
      .then(() => this.loadInsights())
      .then(() => this.loadActivities())
      .then(() => {
        this.addEventToHistory('success', '自动数据同步完成');
      })
      .catch(error => {
        this.addEventToHistory('error', `自动刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
      });
  },
  toggleTheme() {
    const isDarkMode = this.data.get('isDarkMode');
    this.data.set('isDarkMode', !isDarkMode);
  },
  toggleView() {
    const isCompactView = this.data.get('isCompactView');
    this.data.set('isCompactView', !isCompactView);
  },
  onPeriodChange() {
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    this.data.set('selectedPeriod', selectedPeriod);
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `切换时间段为: ${selectedPeriod}`);
    this.loadChartData();
  },
  onSearchChange() {
    const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
    this.data.set('searchQuery', searchQuery);
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `搜索关键词: ${searchQuery || '清空'}`);
  },
  onFilterChange() {
    const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');
    this.data.set('activityFilter', activityFilter);
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `活动类型过滤: ${activityFilter}`);
  },
  onStatClick(stat) {
    this.addEventToHistory('click', `点击统计卡片: ${stat.title} (${stat.value})`);
    this.fire('stat-click', { stat, timestamp: Date.now() });
  },
  onDataPointClick(data) {
    this.addEventToHistory('chart', `点击数据点: 日期 ${data.date}, 值 ${data.value}`);
    this.fire('chart-point-click', data);
  },
  onInsightClick(insight) {
    this.addEventToHistory('insight', `查看洞察: ${insight.title}`);
    this.fire('insight-click', insight);
  },
  onActivityClick(activity) {
    this.addEventToHistory('activity', `查看活动: ${activity.user} - ${activity.type}`);
    this.fire('activity-click', activity);
  },
  formatDateLabel(date, totalDays) {
    if (totalDays <= 30) {
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`;
    }
    return `${date.getMonth() + 1}月`;
  },
  addEventToHistory(type, message) {
    const event = {
      type,
      message,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      timeStr: new Date().toLocaleTimeString()
    };

    const history = this.data.get('eventHistory');
    const newHistory = [event, ...history];
    if (newHistory.length > 50) {
      newHistory.pop();
    }
    this.data.set('eventHistory', newHistory);

    if (typeof console !== 'undefined') {
      console.log(`[${event.timeStr}] ${message}`);
    }
  }
});
</script>

<template>
<div class="analytics-dashboard" class="{{isDarkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}} {{isCompactView ? 'compact' : ''}}">
  <div class="dashboard-navbar">
    <div class="logo-section">
      <span class="logo-icon">📈</span>
      <h1 class="logo-text">Analytics Pro</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-controls">
      <button class="view-toggle" on-click="toggleView">{{isCompactView ? '📊 展开视图' : '📋 紧凑视图'}}</button>
      <button class="theme-toggle" on-click="toggleTheme">{{isDarkMode ? '☀️ 亮色' : '🌙 暗色'}}</button>
      <button class="refresh-btn" disabled="{{isLoading}}" on-click="manualRefresh">{{isLoading ? '⏳ 加载中...' : '🔄 刷新数据'}}</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="stats-grid">
    <stat-card
      s-for="stat in statistics" trackby="stat.id"
      title="{{stat.title}}"
      value="{{stat.value}}"
      change="{{stat.change}}"
      icon="{{stat.icon}}"
      loading="{{isLoading}}"
      on-click="onStatClick(stat)"
    />
  </div>
  <div class="visualization-section">
    <div class="chart-container">
      <h3 class="section-title">
        <span>📊 实时访问趋势</span>
        <select class="period-selector" value="{= selectedPeriod =}" on-change="onPeriodChange">
          <option value="7d">最近7天</option>
          <option value="30d">最近30天</option>
          <option value="90d">最近90天</option>
        </select>
      </h3>
      <trend-chart data="{{chartData}}" height="300" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-data-point-click="onDataPointClick"/>
    </div>
    <div class="insights-panel">
      <h3 class="section-title">💡 智能洞察</h3>
      <insight-list insights="{{insights}}" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-insight-click="onInsightClick"/>
    </div>
  </div>

    <div class="activity-header">
      <h3 class="section-title">📋 实时用户活动</h3>
      <div class="filter-controls">
        <input type="text" placeholder="搜索用户或操作..." class="search-input" value="{= searchQuery =}" on-input="onSearchChange"/>
        <select class="filter-select" value="{= activityFilter =}" on-change="onFilterChange">
          <option value="all">所有活动</option>
          <option value="login">登录</option>
          <option value="purchase">购买</option>
          <option value="view">浏览</option>
          <option value="share">分享</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <activity-table activities="{{filteredActivities}}" loading="{{isLoading}}" on-row-click="onActivityClick"/>

    <p>正在加载最新数据...</p>
  </div>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'StatCard',
  components: {
    'stat-card': require('./StatCard'),
    'trend-chart': require('./TrendChart'),
    'insight-list': require('./InsightList'),
    'activity-table': require('./ActivityTable')
  },
  dataTypes: {
    userId: DataTypes.string,
    apiEndpoint: DataTypes.string
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      isCompactView: false,
      isLoading: false,
      selectedPeriod: '30d',
      searchQuery: '',
      activityFilter: 'all',
      statistics: [
        { id: 1, title: '总访问量', value: 28450, change: 12.5, icon: '👥' },
        { id: 2, title: '新增用户', value: 3240, change: -2.3, icon: '🆕' },
        { id: 3, title: '转化率', value: 3.8, change: 0.7, icon: '🎯' },
        { id: 4, title: '总收入', value: 187500, change: 18.9, icon: '💰' }
      ],
      chartData: [],
      insights: [],
      activities: [],
      dataCache: {
        '7d': null,
        '30d': null,
        '90d': null
      },
      eventHistory: [],
      userId: 'anonymous',
      apiEndpoint: 'https://api.example.com/analytics'
    };
  },
  computed: {
    filteredActivities() {
      const activities = this.data.get('activities');
      let filtered = [...activities];
      const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
      const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');

      if (searchQuery) {
        const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity =>
          activity.user.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          activity.detail.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );
      }

      if (activityFilter !== 'all') {
        filtered = filtered.filter(activity => activity.type === activityFilter);
      }

      return filtered;
    }
  },
  inited() {
    this.watch('isDarkMode', newVal => {
      this.fire('theme-changed', { darkMode: newVal, timestamp: Date.now() });
      this.addEventToHistory('theme', `主题切换为 ${newVal ? '暗色' : '亮色'} 模式`);
    });

    this.watch('isCompactView', newVal => {
      this.addEventToHistory('view', `视图切换为 ${newVal ? '紧凑' : '展开'} 模式`);
    });
  },
  attached() {
    this.initializeDashboard();
    this.startAutoRefresh();
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘初始化完成');
  },
  disposed() {
    const refreshInterval = this.data.get('refreshInterval');
    if (refreshInterval) {
      clearInterval(refreshInterval);
      this.data.set('refreshInterval', null);
    }
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '仪表盘组件即将销毁');
  },
  initializeDashboard() {
    this.data.set('isLoading', true);
    Promise.all([
      this.loadChartData(),
      this.loadInsights(),
      this.loadActivities()
    ]).then(() => {
      this.addEventToHistory('success', '所有数据加载成功');
    }).catch(error => {
      this.addEventToHistory('error', `数据加载失败: ${error.message}`);
      this.fire('error', { message: error.message, timestamp: Date.now() });
    }).finally(() => {
      this.data.set('isLoading', false);
    });
  },
  loadChartData() {
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    if (dataCache[selectedPeriod]) {
      this.data.set('chartData', dataCache[selectedPeriod]);
      this.addEventToHistory('cache', `使用缓存的 ${selectedPeriod} 图表数据`);
      return Promise.resolve();
    }

    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800)).then(() => {
      const days = selectedPeriod === '7d' ? 7 : (selectedPeriod === '30d' ? 30 : 90);
      const data = [];
      let baseValue = 1000;

      for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
        const variance = Math.sin(i * 0.2) * 200;
        const trend = i * 2;
        baseValue += Math.random() * 30 - 15;
        const value = Math.max(100, Math.floor(baseValue + variance + trend));

        const date = new Date();
        date.setDate(date.getDate() - (days - i));

        data.push({
          date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
          label: this.formatDateLabel(date, days),
          value: value
        });
      }

      this.data.set('chartData', data);
      const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: data };
      this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);
      this.addEventToHistory('fetch', `加载了 ${days} 天的图表数据`);
    });
  },
  loadInsights() {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600)).then(() => {
      const insightsData = [
        {
          id: 1,
          title: '用户活跃度提升',
          description: '过去7天用户访问时长增加了23%，主要集中在移动端',
          icon: '🚀',
          color: '#10b981',
          trend: 23,
          timestamp: '2分钟前'
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          title: '转化率优化建议',
          description: '购物车放弃率较高，建议优化结账流程',
          icon: '🛒',
          color: '#f59e0b',
          trend: -5,
          timestamp: '15分钟前'
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          title: '新用户增长高峰',
          description: '社交媒体渠道带来大量新用户，增长42%',
          icon: '📱',
          color: '#3b82f6',
          trend: 42,
          timestamp: '1小时前'
        },
        {
          id: 4,
          title: '服务器响应优化',
          description: 'API响应时间降低15%，用户体验改善',
          icon: '⚡',
          color: '#8b5cf6',
          trend: 15,
          timestamp: '3小时前'
        }
      ];
      this.data.set('insights', insightsData);
    });
  },
  loadActivities() {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500)).then(() => {
      const activities = [];
      const users = ['张三', '李四', '王五', '赵六', '钱七'];
      const types = ['login', 'purchase', 'view', 'share'];
      const details = {
        login: ['登录成功', '登录失败', '异地登录'],
        purchase: ['购买商品A', '购买商品B', '订阅会员'],
        view: ['浏览首页', '查看详情页', '搜索关键词'],
        share: ['分享链接', '邀请好友', '发布评论']
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
        const status = Math.random() > 0.8 ? 'failed' : (Math.random() > 0.9 ? 'pending' : 'success');

        activities.push({
          id: Date.now() + i,
          timestamp: Date.now() - Math.random() * 3600000,
          user: users[Math.floor(Math.random() * users.length)],
          type: type,
          detail: details[type][Math.floor(Math.random() * details[type].length)],
          status: status
        });
      }

      activities.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);
      this.data.set('activities', activities);
    });
  },
  manualRefresh() {
    if (this.data.get('isLoading')) return;

    this.data.set('isLoading', true);
    this.addEventToHistory('action', '用户手动刷新数据');

    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
    this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

    Promise.all([
      this.loadChartData(),
      this.loadInsights(),
      this.loadActivities()
    ]).then(() => {
      this.addEventToHistory('success', '数据刷新完成');
      const statistics = this.data.get('statistics');
      this.fire('data-refreshed', {
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        period: selectedPeriod,
        statistics: statistics
      });
    }).catch(error => {
      this.addEventToHistory('error', `刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
      this.fire('error', { message: error.message });
    }).finally(() => {
      this.data.set('isLoading', false);
    });
  },
  startAutoRefresh() {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!this.data.get('isLoading')) {
        this.autoRefresh();
      }
    }, 30000);
    this.data.set('refreshInterval', interval);
  },
  autoRefresh() {
    this.addEventToHistory('system', '自动刷新数据');
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    const dataCache = this.data.get('dataCache');
    const newDataCache = { ...dataCache, [selectedPeriod]: null };
    this.data.set('dataCache', newDataCache);

    this.loadChartData()
      .then(() => this.loadInsights())
      .then(() => this.loadActivities())
      .then(() => {
        this.addEventToHistory('success', '自动数据同步完成');
      })
      .catch(error => {
        this.addEventToHistory('error', `自动刷新失败: ${error.message}`);
      });
  },
  toggleTheme() {
    const isDarkMode = this.data.get('isDarkMode');
    this.data.set('isDarkMode', !isDarkMode);
  },
  toggleView() {
    const isCompactView = this.data.get('isCompactView');
    this.data.set('isCompactView', !isCompactView);
  },
  onPeriodChange() {
    const selectedPeriod = this.data.get('selectedPeriod');
    this.data.set('selectedPeriod', selectedPeriod);
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `切换时间段为: ${selectedPeriod}`);
    this.loadChartData();
  },
  onSearchChange() {
    const searchQuery = this.data.get('searchQuery');
    this.data.set('searchQuery', searchQuery);
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `搜索关键词: ${searchQuery || '清空'}`);
  },
  onFilterChange() {
    const activityFilter = this.data.get('activityFilter');
    this.data.set('activityFilter', activityFilter);
    this.addEventToHistory('filter', `活动类型过滤: ${activityFilter}`);
  },
  onStatClick(stat) {
    this.addEventToHistory('click', `点击统计卡片: ${stat.title} (${stat.value})`);
    this.fire('stat-click', { stat, timestamp: Date.now() });
  },
  onDataPointClick(data) {
    this.addEventToHistory('chart', `点击数据点: 日期 ${data.date}, 值 ${data.value}`);
    this.fire('chart-point-click', data);
  },
  onInsightClick(insight) {
    this.addEventToHistory('insight', `查看洞察: ${insight.title}`);
    this.fire('insight-click', insight);
  },
  onActivityClick(activity) {
    this.addEventToHistory('activity', `查看活动: ${activity.user} - ${activity.type}`);
    this.fire('activity-click', activity);
  },
  formatDateLabel(date, totalDays) {
    if (totalDays <= 30) {
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`;
    }
    return `${date.getMonth() + 1}月`;
  },
  addEventToHistory(type, message) {
    const event = {
      type,
      message,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      timeStr: new Date().toLocaleTimeString()
    };

    const history = this.data.get('eventHistory');
    const newHistory = [event, ...history];
    if (newHistory.length > 50) {
      newHistory.pop();
    }
    this.data.set('eventHistory', newHistory);

    if (typeof console !== 'undefined') {
      console.log(`[${event.timeStr}] ${message}`);
    }
  }
});
</script>

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理
